sourceOutput.actualSizeDisclosure: The generator returned native 1254x1254 outputs. They were not upscaled or represented as native 2048px images. Runtime rendering derives a maximum tile size from these actual pixels and the display scale, then repeats and mirrors tiles for wider surfaces so no tile is upscaled.
